lines.text: *Whoooosh*
Ah... so refreshing.
Nothing beats a shower after a workout.
*Swish, swish*
I grab both ends of my towel and vigorously dry my hair.
*Swoosh, swoosh*
Then I towel off my worn-out body.
*Slide*
When I step out of the shower room,
I find myself face to face with Privaty, taking off her stockings.
Huh?
With her back to me, Privaty hasn't noticed me as she pulls down her right stocking.
The leg hidden underneath her black stocking is revealed.
I carefully use the towel to wrap around my waist
and slowly attempt to close the shower room door again.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: You don't have to feel uncomfortable.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: There's no rule saying teachers and students can't share the showers—
Seemingly picking up the sound of the door closing, Privaty straightens and looks behind her.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Huh...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Gaaaah!
I rush over to the beet-red Privaty and cover her mouth before she can scream.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Mmmph—!
If you scream, people will come running!
Have you calmed down?
*Nod, nod*
I gingerly remove my hand from Privaty's mouth.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... Whew.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what are you doing here?!
I was drenched in sweat, so I came to wash up.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: There aren't any men at this school, so the shower rooms aren't separated.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And you were sweating a lot earlier.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: ... F-fortunately, I haven't taken my clothes off yet.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: And you may be undressed, but you c-c-covered yourself with your towel, so I didn't see anything.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Now you just have to get dressed again.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Nothing happened, and nothing will happen. Right?
Right.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'll turn around, so hurry and get dressed.
Thanks...
I open my locker and start putting my clothes on.
Or rather, I am about to, when...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Honestly, I do feel a little gross.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Let's wash up quickly and go get something sweet to eat.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah!
Wait a moment... I think some students are coming.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: H-hide! Quickly!
There's nowhere to hide in here!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Do you want to wash up too, Naru?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Even if it's waterproof, isn't it still dangerous?
Their voices are getting closer.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Here, there's a gap here between the wall and the lockers.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Quick, this way!
Privaty grabs my hand and yanks me in.
*Whirr*

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Darn, I didn't bring a change of clothes.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Then why did you go back to your room earlier?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I don't like the communal shampoo here.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I went back to grab the one I use.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Sniff, sniff* No wonder you smell so nice.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It was the shampoo.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I can lend you some if you'd like.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Thanks!
*Swoosh, swoosh*

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Y-you're too close...
You're the one who picked such a cramped spot, Miss Privaty.
I feel Privaty's breath right against my chest,
as my bare skin takes in every trace of her warmth.
Things might get out of hand at this rate...
I reach out and pull Privaty into my arms.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-wh-what're you doing?!
Shhh!
This is the only way I can keep myself together.
With her in my arms, Privaty is forced to turn her head to the side.
Thankfully, her breath no longer brushes against me.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: H-hey...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I don't mind you hugging me...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: But something's pressing against my stomach...
I'm at a loss for words.
Just stay quiet... please...
Privaty reaches out as well,
and gently wraps her arms around my waist.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Um...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: This might not be the best time to say this, but...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: M-maybe...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Maybe you and I could...
Suddenly the door slides open.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Whoa, look at all that steam!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Someone else must've just been in here.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: We didn't run into anyone on the way in though.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ooh!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Maybe they're hiding somewhere to scare us!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Oooh, maybe.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I wonder who it could be!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I love playing hide and seek!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Naru, go look.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Nah, it's more fun if we look for them ourselves.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Using Naru makes it too easy. Where's the fun in that?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: You think so?

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: We're going to get caught at this rate!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'll go out and distract them so you can escape.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Understood?
First, I want to hear what you were about to say earlier.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Wh-what...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I'll tell you another time! Right now, you need to get out of here! Fast!
Privaty steps outside.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Ta-da...!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: It was actually me! Hah... haha...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Wait, what? It was you, Miss Privaty?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I didn't realize you liked doing this sort of thing.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Th-that's right!

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Since I'm your teacher, I thought it might be awkward for us to be naked around each other,

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: So I thought things might get awkward so I decided to surprise you. Haha...

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Well, I'll get undressed and head in.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: Let's wash up together.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Wow, you got undressed really fast.

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: I just want to wash up quickly. That's all.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But the inside is already full of steam.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If you haven't showered yet, then who did—

lines.speaker: privaty_t
lines.text: That's enough, just hurry up and get in!
Privaty waves one hand behind her, gesturing for me to hurry up and leave.
Then she enters the shower room.
*Slide* *Bang*
I take a moment to calm my racing heart, and the other part of me that's even more worked up.
Then I carefully slip out and put on the clothes in my locker.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Wow, you two have incredible figures!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I'll look like that when I graduate too, right?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Please say yes...
Once I finish getting dressed, my nerves settle down, and I start hearing sounds from the shower room.
They seem to be discussing something... quite intriguing.
What should I do...?
Leave the locker room.
Take a quick peek.
Privaty went through hell to give me a chance to escape.
I shouldn't involve myself in things that don't concern me. It's better to just get out of here.
Leaving the noisy shower room behind, I return to the dormitory.
That's right.
Any man would seize an opportunity like this.
Let's do it!
